posts.title: The First Photograph of the Earth From the Moon: A Visual History
posts.description: On August 23, 1966, the team behind NASA’s Lunar Orbiter I captured the first image of Earth as seen from the Moon. You will sometimes see an updated version of this image, in fantastic resolution with all imperfections erased.
